description:
Hushfacebook v0.7.0 targets Facebook 581.0.0.45.58 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release, and 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 still work.

This release gathers everything since v0.6.0 and brings 60 patches, up from 59. The new one is Force dark mode, for tablets whose Settings page has no Dark mode row. A copy made with Clone app now installs next to the official Facebook, the Feeds tab can open on the filter you pick, and the word lists hold up to 1,000 phrases each.

Validation: 1532 runtime tests passed locally. All 697 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 60 patches applied to Facebook 581.0.0.45.58, 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a, Android 11+ bundle of Facebook 581.0.0.45.58, build 475215365. Builds 580.0.0.51.74 (475019344) and 577.0.0.50.72 (474426275) still work. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
